Who we are

West Wales Roofing is Will and a small crew based on the border of Ceredigion and Pembrokeshire, with work spanning Carmarthenshire, Swansea and Cardiff. Slate, tile, flat roofs and storm work, on houses, farm buildings, chapels and commercial units.

Will quotes every job himself and is on site for every one. No sales calls.
